forms.title: New Client Onboarding
forms.description: Collect personal, financial, and regulatory information for new advisory clients under Australian regulations.

fields.label: Welcome to Client Onboarding
fields.description: This form collects personal, financial, and regulatory information required to establish your advisory relationship. All data is handled in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988.

fields.label: Age
fields.description: Used for risk assessment and suitability calculations.

fields.label: Investment Time Horizon (years)
fields.description: 1 = Less than 1 year, 15 = Medium-term, 30 = 30+ years.

fields.label: Risk Tolerance
fields.description: 1 = Very conservative (prefer safety), 10 = Very aggressive (accept high volatility).

fields.label: Risk Score
fields.description: Weighted score (1-100) based on age, investment horizon, and risk tolerance.

fields.label: Wholesale Client Status
fields.description: Corporations Act s761G: gross income >= $250k OR net assets >= $2.5M.

fields.label: Onboarding Complete
fields.description: Thank you for completing the onboarding form. Your adviser will review the information and reach out with next steps.

forms.title: Risk Profile Assessment
forms.description: Assess client risk tolerance and generate a suitability profile for Best Interest Duty compliance.

fields.label: Client Age
fields.description: Confirm the client's current age for suitability calculations.

fields.label: Annual Income (AUD)
fields.description: Confirm the client's annual income for suitability analysis.

fields.label: Net Assets (AUD)
fields.description: Confirm the client's total net assets.

fields.label: Investment Time Horizon (years)
fields.description: 1 = Less than 1 year, 30 = 30+ years.

fields.label: If the market dropped 20% tomorrow, what would you do?
How much portfolio loss can you absorb without affecting your lifestyle?
fields.description: 1 = Very little (< 5%), 10 = Significant (> 40%).

fields.label: Recommended Risk Profile
fields.description: Select the recommended risk profile for this client.

fields.label: Risk Profile Score
fields.description: Weighted suitability score (1-100) based on age, income, net assets, tolerance, and horizon.

fields.label: Best Interest Duty
fields.description: Under s961B of the Corporations Act 2001 (Safe Harbour), the adviser must demonstrate that the advice is in the best interest of the client by taking reasonable steps to ascertain the client's relevant circumstances, objectives, and financial situation.

forms.title: Off-Market Transfer
forms.description: Initiate an off-market transfer of securities between platforms.

validation.message: Please enter a valid HIN (X + 10 digits) or SRN (10 digits).

forms.title: Financial Services Guide Acknowledgement
forms.description: Client acknowledgement of the Financial Services Guide (FSG) as required under the Corporations Act 2001.

fields.label: Financial Services Guide
fields.description: This Financial Services Guide (FSG) is designed to help you decide whether to use any of the financial services we offer. It contains important information about the services we provide, how we and our associates are paid, and how we handle complaints.

fields.label: Services We Provide
fields.description: We are authorised to provide personal financial product advice on superannuation, retirement planning, investment strategies, insurance, and wealth accumulation under our Australian Financial Services Licence (AFSL).

fields.label: How We Are Paid
fields.description: Our fees are based on a percentage of funds under advice, charged monthly or quarterly in arrears. All fees are inclusive of GST. A detailed Fee Disclosure Statement will be provided separately.

fields.label: Associations & Conflicts of Interest
fields.description: We may receive referral fees or commissions from product issuers. Any material associations, relationships, or conflicts of interest that could influence our advice will be disclosed in the Statement of Advice (SOA).

fields.label: Complaints
fields.description: If you have a complaint about our services, please contact us directly. If we are unable to resolve your complaint, you can lodge it with the Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA): GPO Box 3, Melbourne VIC 3001 | 1800 931 678 | info@afca.org.au.

fields.label: Privacy
fields.description: We collect, use, and store your personal information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles. Your information will only be shared with third parties where required to provide our services or as required by law.

forms.title: Annual Client Review
forms.description: Document annual portfolio review, updated goals, and any life changes for each client.

fields.label: Current Annual Fee
fields.description: Tiered advisory fee based on current portfolio value (GST inclusive).

fields.label: Goal Progress
fields.description: 1 = Significantly behind, 5 = On track, 10 = Exceeding goals.

fields.label: Updated Risk Tolerance
fields.description: 1 = Very conservative, 10 = Very aggressive. Leave unchanged if risk profile has not shifted.

fields.label: Statement of Advice Requirement
fields.description: If life changes have occurred, a new Statement of Advice (SOA) may be required to ensure ongoing compliance with the Best Interest Duty under s961B of the Corporations Act.

forms.title: Fee Disclosure Statement
forms.description: Establish advisory fee terms and ongoing fee consent as required under the Corporations Act.

fields.label: Calculated Annual Fee
fields.description: Tiered advisory fee based on portfolio value (GST inclusive).

fields.label: Ongoing Fee Consent
fields.description: Under s962H of the Corporations Act, you must provide consent for ongoing fees to be charged.

fields.label: Fee Disclosure
fields.description: All fees shown are inclusive of GST. This Fee Disclosure Statement is provided in accordance with Division 3 of Part 7.7A of the Corporations Act 2001.

forms.title: Document Vault
forms.description: Securely store and organise client documents including SOAs, PDSs, tax returns, and insurance policies.

properties.placeholder: Enter a name for this document

fields.label: Expiry Date
fields.description: Applicable for insurance policies and other time-limited documents.

forms.title: TFN Declaration
forms.description: Tax File Number declaration for superannuation and investment accounts.

fields.label: TFN Exemption
fields.description: If you do not provide a TFN and have no exemption, tax may be withheld at the highest marginal rate (47%).

fields.label: Withholding Tax Warning
fields.description: If no TFN is quoted and no exemption applies, tax will be withheld at 47% on all investment income and employer contributions.

fields.label: Do you want to claim the tax-free threshold?
Do you have a HECS-HELP, VSL, or other study/training loan?

forms.description: Nominate binding beneficiaries for superannuation death benefits under the SIS Act.

fields.label: BDBN Validity
fields.description: This Binding Death Benefit Nomination is valid for 3 years from the date of signature and must be renewed before expiry to remain in effect.

fields.label: Insurance Warning
fields.description: Rolling over your superannuation may cancel any existing insurance cover (life, TPD, income protection) held within your current fund. Please confirm your insurance arrangements before proceeding.
